release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.8.9 Release — YouTube Shorts Interception & Redirection Engine Overhaul:
• Regain-Class Detection Architecture: Replaced shallow tree recursion with native C++ view ID lookups across all known YouTube Shorts player components (reel_recycler, reel_watch_fragment_root, shorts_container, sound_pivot_button, etc.).
• Fail-Safe Escape Navigation: Fires immediate deep-link intent (https://www.youtube.com/) forcing YouTube out of Shorts and back to the Home lecture screen, alongside Home tab simulation and back-gestures.
• Dual-Layer Feedback: Dispatches haptic warnings, immediate toast notifications, and sleek full-screen overlays so students stay protected even on aggressive OEM skins (Xiaomi HyperOS, Vivo, Oppo).
